# Notebook 0 -- GR6J configuration

**Why GR6J.** GR6J (Pushpalatha et al. 2011) adds an exponential-store
exchange branch designed for low flows -- exactly the structural hypothesis
H2 asks about: *do GR4J and GR6J low-flow projections differ materially,
stratified by aridity/storage?* The guardrail (AGENTS.md, fixed): **divergence
is the signal, never a beauty contest** -- published evidence shows GR4J
sometimes matches observed low flows better in prolonged dry periods, so no
assertion of GR6J superiority; only quantified divergence.

**Identical-treatment rule (pre-registered 18 Nov 2026).** GR6J gets exactly
the same treatment as GR4J everywhere:

| setting | value (same as GR4J/HYD_00) |
|---|---|
| inputs | daily P_mm + PET (Oudin) from `model_inputs/<id>_obs.csv` |
| period / warm-up | 1981-2014, warm-up = all of 1981 (365 d) |
| calibration | 1982-2000, `Calibration_Michel`, objective = 1 - KGE (mm/day) |
| validation | 2001-2014, out-of-sample |
| screening | skip if < 3,650 valid observed Q-days in the calibration window |
| units | Q in mm/day throughout |

The only difference is the model structure: `airGR::RunModel_GR6J`
(6 parameters; X1 production store, X2 exchange, X3 routing store, X4 UH
time base, X5 exponential-store exchange coefficient, X6 exponential-store
capacity).

```{r gr6j-paths, include=FALSE}
gr6j_project_root <- "D:/Datasets/CIMP6_India"
gr6j_output_dir <- file.path(gr6j_project_root, "data_processed", "gr6j")
dir.create(gr6j_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(gr6j_output_dir, "params"), showWarnings = FALSE)
gr6j_log <- function(msg, log_file = file.path(gr6j_output_dir,
                                               "gr6j_log.txt")) {
   line <- paste0(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), " | ", msg)
   cat(line, "\n")
   cat(line, "\n", file = log_file, append = TRUE)
}

# quick-test mode: a handful of catchments
gr6j_test_mode <- FALSE
gr6j_test_ids  <- c("03002", "03005", "03008")
```

**Materiality thresholds for the H2 divergence (pre-registered here, before
any GR6J result exists):** a metric diverges *materially* if the median
absolute GR6J-vs-GR4J divergence is (a) >= 0.10 for `logNSE` (a quarter of
the GR4J validation-median range) or (b) >= 10 percentage points for the
% bias metrics (q95_bias, lf_volume_bias, dry_spell_bias, mam7_bias).
H2 stands if at least one metric diverges materially in at least one aridity
tercile; H2 fails if no metric does anywhere (negative result, reported).
